text:
erin: Sales flagged BigRetail: tenant routing + per-tenant encryption must be in v1 or they'll postpone onboarding. They want dates by next week.
marco: Clarify expectations: tenant routing basic (hostname routing + routing table) vs advanced (shared-domain mapping, vanity domains)?
erin: They want hostname routing + per-tenant KMS keys for compliance. Vanity domains can be v1.1.
dylan: Our public v1 timetable has tenant routing (basic) and encryption as v1, but per-tenant KMS was scoped to post-GA. Moving it earlier impacts infra and security review.
priya: Quick eng read: KMS per-tenant support = ~3w infra changes (key provisioning, rotation hooks), +2w security review + 1w QA. Hostname routing + routing rules ~2w. If prioritized aggressively, combined ~6w.
lena: We can reduce schedule by offering a pilot: implement hostname routing + a managed KMS for 5 pilot tenants (keys in our account but strict access controls) by Jun 25, and full customer-managed tenant KMS (HSM/KMS bring-your-own-key) in v1 GA on Jul 20.
erin: So pilot = managed keys (not BYOK) + routing for 5 tenants, full BYOK + vanity domain support in v1. Does BigRetail accept that compromise?
marco: Tradeoffs: pilot reduces legal/compliance exposure but may be acceptable if we sign limited data-handling attestation and a firm BYOK GA date. Also need to call out cuts.
dylan: Cuts to make room: postpone experiment framework (AB test infra) and persona analytics; those move to v1.1. That frees 2 engs for 4 weeks.
priya: Acceptance criteria for pilot: traffic routing for pilot tenants under their hostnames, managed keys provisioned, key rotation tested, <1% routing errors, audit logs streaming to their SIEM.
lena: Ops note: run pilot in single region (us-east-1), dedicated route table + small pool, feature-flag lock. We'll add runbook + rollback markers.
ops-bot: Created pilot-run SCHED-1101 "tenant-routing-pilot" assigned @lena.
jira-bot: Created TICKET-6602 "tenant-kms-pilot" and linked dependencies  https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/TICKET-6602
erin: Action items: marco -> confirm pilot acceptance with BigRetail today; priya -> PRD for pilot by EOD; lena -> infra + runbook by Thu; dylan -> reassign engineers and update roadmap.
marco: I'll set up a weekly checkpoint with BigRetail and send the pilot offer language.
erin: Decision note (captured): Deliver tenant-routing pilot (hostnames + managed KMS) targeted Jun 25 for 5 pilot tenants; full BYOK + vanity domain support targeted for v1 GA Jul 20. Cuts: experiment framework and persona analytics -> v1.1. Risks: legal sign-off on managed keys, BYOK QA surface.
dylan: ack
priya: ack
lena: ack
erin: I'll update product roadmap and notify stakeholders after pilot acceptance.
